title: Woven or Modular? The Lift-Out Test
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A woven cloth beside three separate building blocks shows why a quiz that is woven into one page cannot be lifted out, while a modular one can.

educational.topic: Woven versus modular design and the lift-out test
learningObjectives: The learner will apply the lift-out test to decide whether a resource is woven or modular, and place it on the degrees of modularity.
prerequisites: The modularity metric and the standalone component from [Chapter 9](../../chapters/09-modularity-metadata/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Can I lift this out and have it still make sense?
What breaks if I change this part?
commonMisconceptions: A long page with headings is already modular
assessmentOpportunities: A quiz refers to "the diagram above". Does it pass the lift-out test?
How does another teacher reuse a woven page?
What is the far end of the degrees of modularity?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
